title: The Last House
plot_overview: A family is suddenly sealed inside their home, where dwindling resources and an ominous outside threat test their ability to stay united. As isolation deepens, they must confront fear, dependence on technology, and the uncertain limits of the place meant to protect them.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like contained survival horror and shifting genre tension; Not for you if you need a brisk pace, fully explored ideas, or a neatly resolved ending.
review_summary: Pros: strong performances; increasingly tense; impressive house setting | Cons: slow first hour; underdeveloped themes; rushed resolution
